result_scope: The one-parameter angular contact ansatz fails at one loop; all rotation-invariant couplings close and obey a positive-flow bound. The bare filled-sea contact interaction has no cutoff-uniform free-energy form bound. Fixed-metric Maxwell throat modes lack a flux-induced frequency separation from the clock.
applicability: Local one-loop running is distinct from the full photon/current stress response and its physical matching. The contact regulator cannot be removed by an angular pair estimate. The global Maxwell spectrum excludes gravito-electromagnetic mixing, physical mouths and exterior radiation.
novelty_boundary: Current OPEs, anisotropic beta functions and current-mode vacuum norms are established framework. The projected-kernel application is an intermediate physical-model audit, not a new accepted research target or completed novelty review.
